english.title: Attempt to cause a female aged 13 or over to engage in a penetrative sexual activity
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) attempted to cause a

(A)_[girl aged13]_
(B)_[girl aged14]_
(C)_[girl aged15]_
(D)_[woman aged 16 or over]_

to engage in sexual activity which would have involved the penetration of

(E)_[her anus]_
(F)_[her vagina]_
(G)_[her mouth with a person's penis]_
(H)_[a person's anus with a part of her body, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PART OF THE BODY..),]_
(I)_[a person's vagina with a part of her body, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PART OF THE BODY..),]_
(J)_[a person's anus by her with a thing, namely **(..SPECIFY THE THING..),]_
(K)_[a person's vagina by her with a thing, namely **(..SPECIFY THE THING..),]_
(L)_[**(..WHERE MORE THAN ONE OF THE ABOVE ACTIVITIES ARE INVOLVED PLEASE SPECIFY..)]_

with intent to do so when she did not consent and you did not reasonably believe that she was consenting
english.legislation: Contrary to section 1(1) of the Criminal Attempts Act 1981.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
attempted to cause
a female aged 13 or over
to engage in sexual activity
which would have involved the penetration of
her anus/vagina/mouth with a persons penis or
a person's anus/vagina with a part of her body or
a person's anus/vagina by her with a thing
with intent to do so
you not reasonably believing that she had consented

investigatoraction.description: Attracts liability for entry on sex offenders register
Consider an application for a sexual harm prevention order after conviction

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See section 72 of, and Schedule 2 to, the Sexual Offences Act 2003 regarding the committing of this offence outside the UK by UK nationals / residents.
(ii) A person guilty of this offence is subject to notification and orders as provided by section 80 of the Act. (Sch 3 paragraph 19).
(iii) Whether a belief is reasonable is to be determined having regard to all the circumstances, including any steps the offender has taken to ascertain whether the victim consented - (section 4(2)).
(iv) IMPORTANT - carefully check an offender's previous convictions. Provisions under sections 224 to 235 of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 may mean that s/he is liable to receive a longer sentence if certain conditions apply.
(v) Victim's age should be proved by reference to a Birth Certificate where possible.
